Passive.Name: Sixty Covers, No Help
Passive.Description: Chef NORMAL_NPC works a Ticket Rail that fills by one every 4 seconds, up to 5 tickets. His next attack spends the whole rail at once, dealing +45% Damage per ticket spent in Splash. Every enemy defeated by a full 5-ticket plate refunds 25 D$ and instantly returns one ticket to the rail.

Passive.Name: hOI!! i'm tEMMIE... EGG
Passive.Description: Every 12 seconds Egg Temmie lays an Egg on the lane. Eggs are stationary and last 45 seconds; the first enemy to touch one takes 4x Egg Temmie's current Damage and is slowed 30% for 3 seconds. Each Egg that hatches on an enemy permanently grants Egg Temmie +2% Damage, up to +60%.

Ability1.Name: LOOSE THE VOLLEY
Ability1.Description: One arrow becomes a sky full of them. The Archer empties the quiver over every enemy in range for 1.15x current Damage, then goes back to counting what's left.

Passive.Name: Draw, Hold, Loose
Passive.Description: Attacks pierce every enemy in a straight line. The Archer holds a Draw that fills by one every 2 seconds up to 4; the next attack spends the entire Draw at once, firing one piercing arrow per point at +80% Damage each and ignoring all enemy damage reduction. Every enemy defeated by a spent Draw permanently adds +1 maximum Draw for the round, up to 8.

Passive.Name: Blocks The B Path
Passive.Description: Enemies cannot walk past B Blocker while it lives. It takes 50% reduced Damage from non-Boss enemies and gains one Barricade stack for every 5 seconds it blocks without dying (maximum 20), each granting +3% maximum Health. At 20 stacks it becomes Immovable and cannot be pushed, pulled or stunned.

Big Bird Berdly.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: Ah, you require the assistance of a GENIUS.
Big Bird Berdly.VoiceLineAttackCaptions: Statistically speaking, you were always going to lose!
Big Bird Berdly.VoiceLineSellCaptions: W-wait, I wasn't finished being smart yet!
Big Bird Berdly.Ability1VoicelineCaptions: Behold! An intellect the size of a BIRD!

Ability1.Name: ACTUALLY, THE STATISTICS SAY
Ability1.Description: Berdly explains, at length, exactly why every enemy in range is wrong. They are pinned in place for 3.7s absorbing 0.53x current Damage per second and, worse, they have to listen.

Ability2.Name: WINGSPAN OF A GENIUS
Ability2.Description: He has been waiting his whole life to be the biggest bird in the room. Berdly unfolds completely and slams the entire cone flat for 1.84x current Damage.

Passive.Name: The Smartest Bird In Hometown (He Says)
Passive.Description: Attacks apply 45% Slow for 3 seconds. Every enemy hit gains one Fact, up to 5; each Fact reduces that enemy's movement speed by a further 8% and its damage by 6%. Every 20 seconds Big Bird Berdly recites the whole lecture, freezing every enemy at 5 Facts for 2.5 seconds and dealing 5x current Damage to them.

Passive.Name: Rooted To The Spot
Passive.Description: Roots seize the first enemy to enter range, holding it for 4 seconds (12 second cooldown per enemy). Rooted enemies take +45% Damage from all sources and cannot regenerate. Every 3rd enemy Rooted causes the roots to spread, holding every enemy within 12 studs for 1.5 seconds.

Passive.Name: Heard It Three Streets Back
Passive.Description: Blue Ears tracks every enemy in range by sound instead of sight, gaining +12% Range and +4% Damage for each enemy currently in range (maximum 5). Enemies that are Slowed or Stunned count double. Cannot be blinded, hidden from, or made to miss.

Passive.Name: Quarterly Projections
Passive.Description: Generates D$ on a timer instead of attacking. Every 30 seconds Business Guy files a Quarterly Report, immediately paying out 3x his current Farm amount and granting every other Farm unit in range +20% output for 15 seconds. Farm output rises 10% for each wave survived, up to +100%.

Passive.Name: Please Do Not Feed
Passive.Description: Every enemy defeated within range is Fed to the cage, permanently granting Cage Animals +3% Damage and +1% Range for the rest of the round (maximum 25 stacks). At 25 stacks the latch gives out: Cage Animals attacks 40% faster and its Splash radius doubles for the remainder of the round.

Passive.Name: Dark Poetry, Darker Aim
Passive.Description: Every 3rd attack deals 2.25x current Damage and applies 30% SoulLeak for 3 seconds. Each enemy defeated by a 3rd attack adds a Verse; every 5 Verses permanently grant +8% Damage. While Jockington is on the board, Verses accumulate twice as fast.

Catlady ERAM.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: Oh, don't mind them, they live here.
Catlady ERAM.Ability1VoicelineCaptions: That's it, all of you at once!
Catlady ERAM.Ability2VoicelineCaptions: You woke them up. That was your mistake.

Ability1.Name: THE WHOLE LITTER
Ability1.Description: She opens the door and does not close it. Cats pour into every corner of the range for 1.28x current Damage, and she apologises to no one.

Ability2.Name: NINE LIVES, SHARED
Ability2.Description: For 7.9s every tower in range is watched over by something with very good night vision, gaining +20% Damage and +5% Cooldown Reduction.

Passive.Name: Far Too Many Cats
Passive.Description: Every 12 seconds a Stray claws the nearest enemy for 2x current Damage and marks it for 6 seconds; marked enemies take +25% Damage from all sources. Each Cat unit on the board grants Catlady ERAM +8% Damage and reduces the Stray timer by 1 second, to a minimum of 4 seconds. Strays that defeat an enemy immediately send another.

Passive.Name: Aged To Perfection
Passive.Description: Cheeseling gains one Age stack every 2 seconds it remains placed, up to 40 stacks. Each stack grants +2% Damage. At 40 stacks Cheeseling becomes Fully Matured, dealing +100% Damage to Bosses and Mini-Bosses. Selling or replacing Cheeseling resets all Age stacks.

Ability1.Name: PEARL OF GREAT PRICE
Ability1.Description: Something he has been keeping since before Hometown had a name comes out of the shell all at once, dealing 1.32x current Damage to everything in range.

Passive.Name: Shell Shocked
Passive.Description: Attacks deal 65% splash Damage within 8 studs and leave enemies Cracked for 5 seconds, taking +25% Damage from all sources and losing 10% of their damage reduction per stack (maximum 4 stacks). Every 35 seconds Clam Guy closes and reopens, releasing a Pearl that deals 8x current Damage to every Cracked enemy on screen.

Ability1.Name: CONTROLLED DEMOLITION
Ability1.Description: The charges were placed hours ago; nobody read the notice. Every enemy in range takes 1.16x current Damage as the whole lot comes down at once.

Ability2.Name: SCAFFOLD UP
Ability2.Description: Aqua throws up frames around the friendly towers in range for 6.3s, giving them +12% Damage and +10% Range while they work from height.

Passive.Name: Hard Hat Area
Passive.Description: Attacks deal full Damage to the primary target and 50% to everything within 10 studs, and enemies defeated refund 6% of her Place Price. Every 30 seconds Construction Aqua sets Charges on the 5 strongest enemies in range; Charges detonate after 4 seconds for 6x current Damage each and chain to anything within 12 studs. All allied units in range are immune to Charge damage.

Passive.Name: Someone's Gotta Pay The Bills
Passive.Description: Deals +35% Damage to enemies above 50% Health. Every enemy defeated grants 60 D$ and one Shift stack; each Shift grants +2% Damage, up to 30 stacks. While Mom Cat is on the board, Dad Cat also gains +25% Damage and takes 20% reduced Damage.

Passive.Name: Pony Up
Passive.Description: Attacks pierce every enemy in a straight line. The last enemy in each pierce line is Marked For The Toll for 5 seconds, taking +50% Damage from all sources and dropping 40 D$ when defeated while Marked. Only one enemy can be Marked For The Toll per attack.

Passive.Name: Dressed To Maul
Passive.Description: Every 4th attack is a Runway Pass, hitting all enemies in range for 1.75x current Damage and applying 35% Bleed (Anti-Regen) for 5 seconds. Each Runway Pass that hits 4 or more enemies grants Applause: +20% Attack Speed for 6 seconds, refreshable.

Passive.Name: Live Wire
Passive.Description: Attacks chain between enemies, stunning each link for 0.3 seconds. Every link after the first adds +10% Damage to the chain instead of losing damage. Enemies struck three times within 5 seconds become Overloaded, taking 2x Electro Dasher's current Damage and stunning for 1 second.

Passive.Name: Rolling Iron
Passive.Description: Every 6 seconds Ferroll rolls the full width of its range, dealing 2x current Damage to everything it passes through and knocking enemies back 4 studs. Each enemy struck by a roll adds +5% Damage to the next roll, up to +100%. Enemies knocked into walls take the roll damage a second time.

Passive.Name: Stop That
Passive.Description: Enemies in range are Stripped: they cannot regenerate Health, cannot be healed by other enemies, and lose 0.5% of their maximum Health every second. Plant units in range deal +20% Damage to Stripped enemies. Stripped persists for 4 seconds after leaving range.

Ability1.Name: SMOTHER EVERYTHING
Ability1.Description: The whole canister goes at once. Every enemy in the cone is buried for 8.1s and takes 0.53x current Damage per second while the room fills up.

Passive.Name: In Case Of Emergency
Passive.Description: Attacks slow heavily and strip all Burn from enemies hit, dealing 5x the removed Burn as instant Damage. Allied units in range cannot be Burned and take 25% reduced Damage from fire sources. Every 40 seconds the canister empties completely, smothering every enemy in range for 3 seconds and rendering them unable to attack.

Passive.Name: Casual Menace
Passive.Description: Deals +40% Damage to enemies that are Slowed, Stunned, Burning or Bleeding. Attacks apply 25% Bleed (Anti-Regen) for 3 seconds. Every enemy defeated while Bleeding grants Flannel Demon +3% Attack Speed for the rest of the round, up to +75%.

Ability1.Name: EVERYTHING IN FULL FLOWER
Ability1.Description: The garden stops being decorative. Every enemy in range is swallowed for 6.7s, taking 0.63x current Damage per second while she decides what gets pruned.

Passive.Name: Bloom Protocol
Passive.Description: Every 18 seconds Flower Queen Blooms, dealing 3x current Damage in a doubled radius and granting all towers in range +20% Damage for 8 seconds. Each Bloom plants one Petal on the lane, up to 8; Petals deal 1x her current Damage to any enemy that touches them and never expire. At 8 Petals every Bloom replants all of them at once.

Passive.Name: Don't Pick On The Bouquet
Passive.Description: Enemies accumulate Interest while in range: +1.5% Damage taken per second, up to +90%, persisting for 5 seconds after leaving range. Enemies defeated at maximum Interest drop 3x D$ and grant Flower Shop Loox +2% Range for the round, up to +40%.

Passive.Name: Frothing At The Seams
Passive.Description: Attacks leave a Puddle dealing 20% of Fommt's current Damage per second for 3 seconds. Puddles that overlap merge into a Slick, dealing 50% of current Damage per second and slowing enemies in it by 40%. A maximum of 6 Puddles can exist at once.

Ability1.Name: EVERYTHING THAT SHOULDN'T BE HERE
Ability1.Description: Flowery stops being polite about which plants belong. The cone is cleared for 7.8s at 0.54x current Damage per second, roots and all.

Passive.Name: Weeding Season
Passive.Description: Fires continuously in a cone. Enemies below 20% Health in the cone are Uprooted instantly (Bosses instead take 10x current Damage). Each Uprooting adds one Cutting, and every 10 Cuttings permanently grant +10% Damage and +5% cone width for the round. Cuttings are never lost.

Passive.Name: Tend The Beds
Passive.Description: Gardener Toriel keeps a Bed of up to 3 allied units in range. Bedded units are healed on a timer and regain 1% of their maximum Health every second while at least one enemy is in range. Any unit healed to full while Bedded gains +12% Damage for 6 seconds.

GIGA Gaster.VoiceLineSellCaptions: It never happened. It never will have happened.
GIGA Gaster.Ability1VoicelineCaptions: BEWARE THE MAN WHO SPEAKS IN HANDS.
GIGA Gaster.Ability3VoicelineCaptions: THE NEXT EXPERIMENT SEEMS TO BE… A SUCCESS.

Ability1.Name: HANDS ACROSS THE VOID
Ability1.Description: Something enormous reaches through where the wall used to be and closes on the single most dangerous enemy in range for 1.36x current Damage. The hand does not come back.

Ability2.Name: PHOTON READINGS NEGATIVE
Ability2.Description: For 7.4s the light in the lane stops behaving. Every tower in range gains +20% Damage and +10% Cooldown Reduction, and nobody asks where the extra time came from.

Ability3.Name: ENTRY NUMBER SEVENTEEN
Ability3.Description: The blasters open in a ring nobody will remember seeing. Every enemy in range is held inside it for 7s, taking 0.97x current Damage per second until the record is clean.

Passive.Name: [REDACTED FROM THE TIMELINE]
Passive.Description: Blasterfall is a hybrid of Pierce Spread and Nuke. Three Gaster Blasters materialise above the lane and fire beams at a 90 degree spread, each passing through every enemy in its line; where a beam terminates it detonates for 30-stud Nuke Damage. Every beam ignores enemy damage reduction and applies 45% SoulLeak for 5 seconds. Enemies defeated by GIGA Gaster are Struck From The Record: they do not count as defeated for any wave, quest or reward tracker, and he permanently gains +1% Damage for each one, up to 150 stacks. Every 45 seconds he leaves the board entirely for 4 seconds, untargetable and unkillable, and returns firing at double speed for 10 seconds.

Passive.Name: Crowd Pleaser
Passive.Description: Attacks set enemies alight. Glad Dragon gains +8% Attack Speed for every enemy currently Burning in range, up to +48%. Every 20 seconds it performs a Finale, instantly consuming all Burn on every enemy in range and dealing 6x the consumed Burn as Damage.

Passive.Name: Struck Gold
Passive.Description: Every 10th attack is a Strike, dealing 5x current Damage and granting 300 D$. Each enemy defeated by a Strike permanently reduces the counter by 1, to a minimum of every 5th attack. While Suilver Sam is on the board, Strikes also grant 150 D$ to him.

Ability1.Name: WHAT THE GREEN TOOK
Ability1.Description: The colour goes out of the whole lane. Everything in range burns at 0.65x current Damage per second for 7.6s and the smoke comes out the wrong shade.

Passive.Name: It Doesn't Go Out
Passive.Description: Burn applied by Green Fire never expires while the enemy lives and stacks up to 8 times. Enemies defeated while Burning pass their full Burn stack count to the nearest enemy within 15 studs. Every 30 seconds the colour deepens: all Burn on screen is doubled in stack count for 10 seconds.

Passive.Name: Please Take A Number
Passive.Description: All towers in range attack faster. Hand Receptionist also keeps a Queue of the 3 towers in range that have gone longest without attacking; those towers receive double the Cooldown boost. Does not attack enemies.

Harley Riders.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: Heard there was trouble down this road.

Ability1.Name: RIDE THE WHOLE LANE
Ability1.Description: Both bikes take the path at once, from the spawn to the base and back, dealing 0.94x current Damage to everything they clip on the way through.

Ability2.Name: KEEP UP OR GET LEFT
Ability2.Description: For 6.8s the towers in range are pulled along in the slipstream, gaining +13% Damage and +5% Cooldown Reduction.

Passive.Name: Two Bikes, One Lane
Passive.Description: Fires two piercing shots per attack at separate targets, and gains +5% Attack Speed for every 10 seconds on the board, up to +60%. Every 35 seconds both bikes Ride Out, travelling the full lane and dealing 5x current Damage to everything they clip, then returning with +50% Damage for 10 seconds.

Passive.Name: What's Under There
Passive.Description: Every 5th attack pulls something out from under the hat, dealing 3x current Damage and stunning for 1 second. Whatever comes out is different each time: it either grants 300 D$, heals Hat Monster to full, or grants +25% Damage for 8 seconds. While Head Hathy is on the board, two things come out at once.

Passive.Name: Head Of The Household
Passive.Description: All towers in range deal more Damage; all Hathy units in range receive double the boost. Every 25 seconds Head Hathy Presides, granting every tower in range an extra +30% Damage for 8 seconds. Does not attack enemies.

Ability1.Name: ANIMATRONIC MALFUNCTION
Ability1.Description: The song loops, then stops. Ice-E holds every enemy in range still for 4.6s, dealing 0.53x current Damage per second while the eyes keep tracking.

Passive.Name: Ice-E Says Hi!
Passive.Description: Attacks apply a heavy slow, and slowed enemies take +30% Damage from all sources. Every 30 seconds the show starts: for 8 seconds Ice-E attacks 60% faster and every enemy hit is Frozen for 1 second on the third hit. Enemies defeated during the show grant 500 D$ and extend the show by 1 second.

Passive.Name: Select All
Passive.Description: Every second attack fires twice in the same frame. Every 15 seconds Icon Man performs a Select All, marking every enemy in range for 4 seconds; Marked enemies take +20% Damage from all sources and his next attack strikes every Marked enemy simultaneously.

Irritable Ghost.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: I was having a perfectly fine afternoon.
Irritable Ghost.VoiceLineAttackCaptions: You are all being extremely inconsiderate.
Irritable Ghost.Ability1VoicelineCaptions: That is ENOUGH out of all of you.

Ability1.Name: I ASKED YOU NICELY
Ability1.Description: The temperature drops about four degrees and the asking stops. The most dangerous enemy in range takes 1.23x current Damage and is not asked anything again.

Ability2.Name: EVERYBODY OUT
Ability2.Description: For 4.6s the room simply stops permitting enemies to move. They stand there taking 0.79x current Damage per second, being glared at.

Ability3.Name: THE HAUNTING PROPER
Ability3.Description: It gives up on manners. Every enemy in range is inside the haunting for 6.7s, taking 0.85x current Damage per second from something extremely annoyed.

Passive.Name: Would You Please Leave
Passive.Description: Cold Shoulder is a continuous AOE that never re-targets. It applies its Damage to every enemy in range four times a second and, unlike other continuous attacks, cannot be interrupted, blocked or made to miss. Enemies standing in it are Being Glared At: their outgoing damage is reduced 35%, their movement speed 25%, and they gain one point of Rudeness every second, up to 30. Each point makes them take a further 4% Damage from Irritable Ghost. At 30 Rudeness an enemy is finally asked to leave, taking 20x current Damage and being pushed back to the start of the lane; Bosses are instead Stunned for 4 seconds. Irritable Ghost cannot be targeted by enemies for the first 15 seconds after placement.

Passive.Name: Solve It Or Stay
Passive.Description: The first enemy to enter range is Locked in a puzzle for 5 seconds and cannot move or attack. 10 second cooldown. Locked enemies take +40% Damage from all sources. If a Locked enemy is defeated before the puzzle ends, the cooldown is halved.

Passive.Name: Comes Apart, Goes Back Together
Passive.Description: When Jigsaw Joe would be defeated he instead reassembles at 40% Health, once per wave. Each reassembly permanently grants +15% Damage and +10% Attack Speed for the round. While Jigsawry is on the board, reassembly is instant and costs no wave charge.

Passive.Name: Missing A Piece
Passive.Description: Deals +60% Damage to enemies below half Health. Each enemy defeated below half Health leaves a Piece; at 4 Pieces Jigsawry consumes them to fire an Assembled shot dealing 5x current Damage in a doubled Splash radius.

Ability1.Name: ONE LAST NUMBER
Ability1.Description: He does not stop playing when the wave arrives. For 6.6s the cone is nothing but sound, dealing 0.95x current Damage per second to everything caught in it.

Passive.Name: Everybody Knows Jockington
Passive.Description: Grants all towers in range +12% Damage. Every 12 seconds he plays a Chord, dealing 2.5x current Damage in a wide cone. Each Chord adds one note to a Set, and on the 4th note the Set resolves: every tower in range immediately attacks twice and gains +30% Damage for 6 seconds.

Passive.Name: Small But Committed
Passive.Description: Attacks twice per cycle against a single target. Kooby gains +40% Damage while it is the only unit covering its tile. Each consecutive attack on the same enemy adds +8% Damage, up to +80%, resetting when the target changes.

Passive.Name: Mastered The Blade
Passive.Description: Every 3rd attack deals 2.5x current Damage and cannot be blocked or reduced. Gains +20% Damage for each other Master unit on the board. Every 3rd attack that defeats an enemy immediately readies the next 3rd attack.

Lollipop Flowery.VoiceLineSellCaptions: Aw. And I had so many left.
Lollipop Flowery.Ability2VoicelineCaptions: You're going to LOVE this flavour.

Ability1.Name: ONE FOR EVERYONE
Ability1.Description: Flowery hands them out to every enemy in range whether they put their hand up or not, dealing 1.01x current Damage on the way down.

Ability2.Name: STUCK ON IT
Ability2.Description: The whole lane goes tacky underfoot. Enemies in range are held for 4.4s taking 0.9x current Damage per second, pulling and getting nowhere.

Passive.Name: Sickly Sweet
Passive.Description: Attacks coat enemies in Sugar for 4 seconds: 40% Slow and +25% Damage taken from Splash sources. Sugar stacks up to 3 times; at 3 stacks the enemy is Stuck and cannot move at all for 2 seconds. Every enemy defeated while Stuck drops a Lollipop that Sugars the next enemy to touch it.

Passive.Name: Venom Before Teeth
Passive.Description: Attacks pierce every enemy in a straight line and apply Venom for 3 seconds. Venom deals 8% of Manticore's current Damage per second and stacks up to 5 times. An enemy defeated at 5 Venom stacks spreads 2 stacks to every enemy within 10 studs.

Mantis Lady.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: You'll want to stand still for this.
Mantis Lady.Ability2VoicelineCaptions: Hold still. It's faster that way.

Ability1.Name: SCISSOR CLOSE
Ability1.Description: The arms come together on the single most dangerous enemy in range for 1.03x current Damage. There is no second motion.

Ability2.Name: A HUNDRED CUTS
Ability2.Description: She works the whole range over for 5.7s at 1.27x current Damage per second, unhurried, methodical, and entirely unbothered.

Passive.Name: Both Arms At Once
Passive.Description: Attacks strike twice. Every 5th attack executes any non-Boss enemy below 18% Health instantly and deals 4x current Damage to everything else it hits. Each execution permanently grants +10% Damage for the round with no cap, and reduces the counter to every 4th attack for 8 seconds.

Marigold The Giant Rat.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: This is her tunnel. You're just in it.
Marigold The Giant Rat.VoiceLineSellCaptions: She'll be back. They always come back.
Marigold The Giant Rat.Ability2VoicelineCaptions: The whole nest is awake now.

Ability1.Name: OUT OF THE WALLS
Ability1.Description: Everything Marigold has ever shared a tunnel with arrives at once, dealing 1.2x current Damage to every enemy in range before disappearing again.

Ability2.Name: SHE KNOWS THE WAY
Ability2.Description: For 7.4s the towers in range are shown the shortcuts, gaining +20% Damage and +6% Cooldown Reduction.

Passive.Name: She Was Here First
Passive.Description: Deals +55% Damage to any enemy that has already walked past her once, and enemies she defeats grant +10% bonus D$. Every 30 seconds the walls open: 6 rats emerge along the lane, each dealing 3x her current Damage to the first enemy they touch before disappearing. While Mouse Millian is on the board, 9 rats emerge instead.

Passive.Name: Just Looking
Passive.Description: Milk Looker Watches one enemy at a time. The Watched enemy takes +35% Damage from all sources, cannot become untargetable, and is revealed to every tower on the board. If the Watched enemy is defeated, the next enemy is Watched instantly with the bonus increased to +45% for 5 seconds.

Ability1.Name: EVERYONE BEHIND ME
Ability1.Description: She steps forward and the lane rearranges itself around that. For 7.8s every tower in range gains +13% Damage and +8% Cooldown Reduction, and nothing gets through her.

Passive.Name: Not While I'm Here
Passive.Description: Heals allied units on a timer and reduces damage they take by 25% while still attacking. Any allied unit in range that would be defeated is instead restored to 40% Health, once per unit per round. Each save permanently grants Mom Cat +20% Damage and +10% Range for the round. While Dad Cat is on the board, saves refresh every 60 seconds instead of once per round.

Passive.Name: Cheese Money
Passive.Description: Every 8th attack is a Crumb Run, dealing 2x current Damage and granting 400 D$. Mouse Millian also collects 15 D$ each time an enemy is defeated anywhere in range by any unit. While Marigold The Giant Rat is on the board, all D$ from this passive is doubled.

Passive.Name: Impeccable
Passive.Description: Attacks never miss and ignore 25% of enemy damage reduction. Every 5th attack is Impeccable, ignoring 100% of enemy damage reduction and dealing +75% Damage. Mr. Elegance cannot be slowed, stunned, or debuffed by enemies.

Passive.Name: Networking Opportunity
Passive.Description: Generates D$ on a timer while still attacking. Gains +12% output for every other Farm unit on the board. Every 35 seconds Mr. Society calls a Function, granting every allied unit in range +15% Damage for 10 seconds and paying out 2x his Farm amount.

Mr. Trophy.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: And the award goes to— well. Obviously.
Mr. Trophy.VoiceLineSellCaptions: I'll be keeping the trophy, thank you.
Mr. Trophy.Ability2VoicelineCaptions: Everyone here is a winner. Except them.
Mr. Trophy.Ability3VoicelineCaptions: And now, the category you've all been waiting for.

Ability1.Name: THE ENVELOPE, PLEASE
Ability1.Description: He reads out one name. The single most dangerous enemy in range takes 1.25x current Damage and does not get to give a speech.

Ability2.Name: CAREER ACHIEVEMENT
Ability2.Description: For 6.6s every tower in range is having the night of its life, gaining +18% Damage and +6% Cooldown Reduction.

Ability3.Name: CLEAR THE STAGE
Ability3.Description: The music starts playing them off and does not stop. Every enemy in range is pinned for 4.1s taking 0.95x current Damage per second.

Passive.Name: First Place, Every Time
Passive.Description: Silverware is a hybrid of Cone AOE and Damage Boost. Mr. Trophy hurls the year's winnings in a 90 degree arc, and every trophy that connects is simultaneously awarded to the highest-DPS allied unit in range, granting it a stacking +2% Damage for 8 seconds. All towers in range also deal more Damage and attack faster at all times. Every 20 seconds he holds a Ceremony: the highest-DPS tower in range is named Winner for 8 seconds, gaining double Damage, double Range and half Cooldown, while every other tower in range gains +25% Damage. A tower named Winner three times becomes a Career Winner and keeps +40% Damage for the rest of the round. Mr. Trophy can never be named Winner and cannot receive boosts from any unit.

Ability1.Name: A WORD WITH ALL OF YOU
Ability1.Description: She addresses the entire range at once, and the entire range takes 1.27x current Damage for it.

Passive.Name: Known Around Here
Passive.Description: Grants all towers in range +15% Damage and deals +40% Damage to enemies within 10 studs. Every 25 seconds she Has A Word with the strongest enemy in range, reducing its damage by 50% and its movement speed by 35% for 8 seconds. Enemies defeated while Had A Word With grant every tower in range 2 seconds of cooldown refund.

Ability1.Name: EVERYONE KNOWS EVERYONE
Ability1.Description: The chain stops choosing and simply includes everybody. Every enemy in range is linked for 7.8s and takes 1.12x current Damage per second through the connection.

Passive.Name: Friend Of A Friend Of A Friend
Passive.Description: Attacks chain to up to 5 enemies with no damage falloff, applying 15% SoulLeak for 3 seconds per link. Every enemy linked becomes an Acquaintance for 6 seconds; when an Acquaintance is defeated, the chain immediately jumps to every other Acquaintance on screen for 1x current Damage. Maximum 12 Acquaintances at once.

Passive.Name: Loud On Purpose
Passive.Description: Attacks deal full Damage to the primary target and 50% to everything within 10 studs. Each enemy caught in the same explosion adds +15% Damage to that explosion, up to +90%. Every 5th explosion is a Big One, doubling the radius and stunning everything hit for 1 second.

Passive.Name: Wrapped Up
Passive.Description: Attacks slow enemies heavily. Enemies hit 3 times become Bound for 5 seconds, taking +25% Damage from all sources and losing all movement bonuses. Bound enemies defeated in range restore 1 second of cooldown to every allied unit in range.

Passive.Name: On Shift
Passive.Description: Heals allied units and the Base on a timer while attacking. Healed units gain Treated for 5 seconds: +12% Damage and immunity to Burn and Bleed. Any allied unit that would be defeated in range is instead restored to 25% Health once every 45 seconds.

Passive.Name: Blocks The O Path
Passive.Description: Enemies cannot walk past O Blocker while it lives. It takes 50% reduced Damage and regenerates 3% of maximum Health per second while no enemy is in range. While B Blocker is also on the board, both gain +40% Health and reflect 20% of damage taken.

Passive.Name: The Clock Is Always Running
Passive.Description: Pizza Pants runs a Delivery Timer that resets on every kill. For each full 3 seconds without a kill he gains +20% Attack Speed, up to +120%. The first attack after the timer resets is a Late Delivery, dealing 3x current Damage in Splash and refunding 100 D$.

Passive.Name: Grounded, Barely
Passive.Description: Attacks chain between enemies, stunning each for 0.4 seconds and dealing double Damage to robotic enemies. Every 5th chain is a Surge, doubling the chain length and dealing 2x current Damage per link. While Electro Dasher is on the board, every chain link also applies 20% Slow for 2 seconds.

Passive.Name: Strong Opinions
Passive.Description: Every 10 seconds Politics Bear makes a Point, dealing 2.5x current Damage in a cone and applying Talked Down for 5 seconds: affected enemies deal 25% less damage and move 15% slower. Each Point that lands on 5 or more enemies permanently adds +4% Damage, up to +60%.

Ability1.Name: EVERY DOOR AT ONCE
Ability1.Description: The spread stops spreading and becomes a wall. Every enemy in range takes 1.1x current Damage and finds all the exits are the same exit.

Passive.Name: Not From Around Here
Passive.Description: Fires three piercing shots applying 25% SoulLeak for 4 seconds. Every 30 seconds Purple Guy steps through, repositioning to the densest cluster of enemies on the lane for 6 seconds and firing five shots instead of three. Enemies defeated during this deal 1x his current Damage to everything within 10 studs.

Passive.Name: Off The Leash
Passive.Description: Every 4th attack Latches On, dealing 2x current Damage and holding the enemy in place for 1.5 seconds. While an enemy is Latched, Puppy Kris attacks it 50% faster and it takes +30% Damage from all sources. Latch cannot be applied to the same enemy twice within 8 seconds.

Passive.Name: Question Three Of Three
Passive.Description: Attacks stun enemies briefly. Stunned enemies take +40% Damage from all sources. Every enemy stunned three times becomes Eliminated: it takes 3x Quiz Vortex's current Damage instantly and drops double D$ if defeated by it.

Passive.Name: Fast Little Thing
Passive.Description: Attacks extremely quickly. Every attack adds one Bounce, up to 10; each Bounce grants +5% Attack Speed. At 10 Bounces the next attack is a Rush dealing 4x current Damage to 3 enemies at once, consuming all Bounces.

Passive.Name: Keeps An Eye On The Street
Passive.Description: Grants all towers in range +10% Range. Deals +30% Damage to enemies at the far edge of her cone. Every 20 seconds she Calls It In, revealing and marking every enemy on screen for 5 seconds; marked enemies take +15% Damage from all sources.

Ability1.Name: MAXIMUM SUCTION
Ability1.Description: The dial goes past where the dial goes. Every enemy in the cone is dragged back and held for 3.4s, taking 0.75x current Damage per second the whole way.

Passive.Name: Suction Set To Prince
Passive.Description: Continuously pulls enemies in the cone 3 studs backwards while damaging them; pulled enemies take +25% Damage. Every enemy defeated adds 1% to the Bag, up to 100%. At a full Bag, Ralsei Henry Hoover empties it: 12x current Damage to every enemy in range and the Bag resets to zero.

Passive.Name: Mastered The Lesson
Passive.Description: Grants all towers in range +12% Damage and +6% Attack Speed. Every 18 seconds Ralsei Master Recites, refreshing every ability cooldown in range by 4 seconds. Gains +20% Damage for each other Master unit on the board.

Passive.Name: Hop To It
Passive.Description: Every 5th attack Leaps to the furthest enemy in range, dealing 2.5x current Damage on landing and stunning everything within 8 studs for 0.5 seconds. Each Leap that defeats an enemy reduces the counter to every 3rd attack for the next 10 seconds.

Passive.Name: Holds Everything
Passive.Description: Takes 40% reduced Damage and cannot be knocked back, stunned, or moved. Royal Coatrack Holds one item from each enemy it defeats, permanently gaining +2% Damage and +1% Health per item, up to 40 items.

Passive.Name: Long Patrol
Passive.Description: Attacks pierce every enemy in a straight line. Ruddin Ranger gains +2% Range every 5 seconds on the board, up to +40%. Every enemy that escapes the lane permanently grants +10% Damage for the round, up to +100%, because it should not have happened again.

Passive.Name: Unidentified, Unbothered
Passive.Description: Cannot be targeted by ground enemies. Every 20 seconds Saucer UFO Abducts the single strongest non-Boss enemy in range, removing it from the lane for 5 seconds and returning it at the same position with 40% less maximum Health. Bosses are instead slowed 60% for 5 seconds.

Ability1.Name: THE LONG SCARF
Ability1.Description: It turns out there was considerably more of it than anyone assumed. Every enemy in range is wound up for 3.5s and takes 0.46x current Damage per second inside it.

Passive.Name: Wrapped Against The Cold
Passive.Description: Attacks slow heavily, and all towers in range take 20% reduced Damage. Every enemy hit adds one Loop, up to 20. At 20 Loops the scarf pulls tight: every enemy in range is held for 2.5 seconds and takes 6x current Damage, consuming all Loops.

Passive.Name: No Jokes Today
Passive.Description: Deals +50% Damage to Bosses and Mini-Bosses. Below 50% Health Serious Trashy enters Dead Serious: +40% Damage, +25% Attack Speed, and immunity to slows for the rest of the round. Dead Serious cannot be removed by healing.

Passive.Name: Keeps Going
Passive.Description: Regenerates 2% of maximum Health per second and returns 20% of all damage taken to the attacker. Every enemy defeated in range is Absorbed, permanently granting +1.5% maximum Health and +1% Damage. When Shambling Mass would die it instead reverts to 50% Health once per round.

Ability1.Name: BAD TIME, MODERATELY
Ability1.Description: The bones come up out of the floor without much ceremony. Every enemy in range takes 0.98x current Damage and gets the point.

Passive.Name: you're gonna have a bad time. probably.
Passive.Description: Attacks ignore all enemy damage reduction and apply 30% SoulLeak for 4 seconds. The first hit on any enemy deals exactly 1 Damage; every hit after that on the same enemy deals 4x current Damage. Enemies that leave and re-enter range keep their count. Snas dodges the first enemy attack aimed at him every 10 seconds.

Passive.Name: One Shot At A Time
Passive.Description: Very long range. Always targets the highest-Health enemy in range and deals +50% Damage to it. Each second spent without firing adds +25% Damage to the next shot, up to +200%. Shots that defeat their target grant 200 D$.

Passive.Name: Small Scope
Passive.Description: Very long range. Each consecutive attack on the same enemy adds one Sight stack (+12% Damage each, maximum 6). At 6 stacks the next shot is a Called Shot, piercing every enemy in a line for 3x current Damage and consuming all stacks.

Passive.Name: A Colder Court
Passive.Description: Attacks slow every enemy in range. Enemies slowed below 40% movement speed become Frostbound: they take +45% Damage from all sources and cannot be healed. Every 30 seconds the court freezes over, stunning every Frostbound enemy for 2 seconds.

Passive.Name: On Duty, Sort Of
Passive.Description: Attacks slow enemies. Snowy builds one Shift stack every 5 seconds on the board (maximum 12), each granting +4% Damage. Taking damage removes 2 stacks. While Snowys Father is on the board, Shift stacks are never lost.

Passive.Name: Show Him How It's Done
Passive.Description: Slow, heavy attacks. Every 4th attack freezes everything hit for 1.5 seconds. While Snowy is on the board, Snowys Father grants him +30% Damage and every 4th attack instead freezes for 2.5 seconds and shatters, dealing 2x current Damage to frozen enemies.

Ability1.Name: STAY DETERMINED
Ability1.Description: It refuses, out loud, in red. For 8.2s every tower in range gains +20% Damage and +12% Cooldown Reduction and simply does not stop.

Passive.Name: Determination Itself
Passive.Description: SOUL cannot be permanently defeated: at zero Health it shatters and reforms at full Health after 8 seconds, and every reform permanently grants +25% Damage for the round. All towers in range gain +12% Damage. While shattered, every tower in range gains +40% Damage until SOUL returns.

Passive.Name: [[Legally Distinct]]
Passive.Description: Every 7th attack fires a [[Sales Pitch]], dealing 3x current Damage and granting 500 D$. Enemies hit by a Sales Pitch are [[Subscribed]] for 8 seconds, taking +30% Damage from all sources and dropping double D$ on defeat.

Passive.Name: Second Place Metal
Passive.Description: Every 8th attack deals 4x current Damage. Suilver Sam gains +35% Damage while Goulden Sam is on the board, and +70% instead while Goulden Sam is within 20 studs. Enemies defeated by the 8th attack grant 250 D$.

Passive.Name: Mastered Hitting Things
Passive.Description: Every 3rd attack deals 2.75x current Damage in a wide arc. Gains +20% Damage for each other Master unit on the board. Each 3rd attack that hits 3 or more enemies grants +15% Attack Speed for 6 seconds, stacking twice.

Passive.Name: Cuts Straight Through
Passive.Description: Attacks pierce every enemy in a straight line and deal +40% Damage to enemies with armour or damage reduction. Every 6th attack is a Cleave, ignoring 100% of enemy damage reduction and applying 35% SoulLeak for 4 seconds to everything in the line.

Passive.Name: Terry.
Passive.Description: Each consecutive hit on the same enemy doubles the damage of the next hit, up to 8x, resetting on target change. Terry does not change target on his own while the current target lives. Enemies defeated at 8x drop triple D$.

Passive.Name: Mastered The Bar
Passive.Description: Act abilities used by towers in range cost 25% less TP, and the team gains +2 TP per second. Every 30 seconds Tp Master enters Focus, refunding the full TP cost of the next Act used by any tower in range. Gains +20% Damage for each other Master unit on the board.

Ability1.Name: MIGRATION SEASON
Ability1.Description: Everything with wings in the general area arrives at the same moment, dealing 1.39x current Damage to every enemy in range before leaving just as suddenly.

Passive.Name: Feathers From Somewhere Warmer
Passive.Description: Every 15 seconds the bird takes flight, becoming untargetable for 4 seconds and returning with double Damage for 6 seconds. Each flight leaves one Feather on the lane, up to 6; Feathers grant every tower within 12 studs +8% Attack Speed and never expire. While Big Bird Berdly is on the board, flights last 2 seconds longer.

Ability1.Name: NO RECORD OF THIS
Ability1.Description: Whatever happens next is not written down. The most dangerous enemy in range takes 0.9x current Damage from a source the log declines to name.

Passive.Name: No Entry Found
Passive.Description: Attacks deal an additional 3% of the target's maximum Health as Damage (0.5% against Bosses) and cannot be blocked, reduced, reflected, or dodged. Every 45 seconds Unknown is Not There: it becomes untargetable and unkillable for 6 seconds while continuing to attack. Enemies defeated by Unknown leave no corpse and drop no D$.

Passive.Name: Nobody Saw It Come Off The Hook
Passive.Description: The first attack against each enemy deals 3x current Damage. White Cloak is untargetable for the first 4 seconds after placement and after each 20 second interval, during which its attacks always count as first attacks.

Passive.Name: Hair Routine Subroutine
Passive.Description: Attacks chain to up to 4 enemies. Every 12 seconds Wig Robot Reboots, clearing all debuffs from itself and gaining +50% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. Each Reboot permanently adds +1 chain length for the round, up to 8.

Passive.Name: Against The Gale
Passive.Description: Attacks push enemies back 5 studs and deal +30% Damage to enemies currently being pushed. Every 15 seconds the wind turns, pushing every enemy in range back 15 studs and dealing 2x current Damage to any that collide with another enemy.

Passive.Name: Under The Soil
Passive.Description: When attacked, Worm burrows and becomes untargetable for 2 seconds (10 second cooldown). The attack it emerges with deals +75% Damage and ignores all enemy damage reduction. While burrowed Worm regenerates 5% of maximum Health per second.

Passive.Name: Wrapped And Ready
Passive.Description: Every 6th attack is a Wrapping, binding the target for 3 seconds: it is slowed 50%, cannot regenerate, and takes +25% Damage from all sources. Enemies defeated while Wrapped leave a Bundle that slows the next enemy to walk over it by 50% for 2 seconds.

Passive.Name: Absolutely, Yes, Of Course
Passive.Description: All towers in range deal more Damage, and every booster unit in range has its boost increased by 25%. Every 20 seconds Yes Man Agrees, copying the strongest single boost currently in range and applying it a second time for 8 seconds. Does not attack enemies.

Passive.Name: Looking Inward
Passive.Description: Zen Looker gains +4% Damage every second in which it does not defeat an enemy, with no cap, and loses all of it on a kill. At 25 stacks it enters Stillness: attacks also hit every enemy in range for 50% of current Damage until the stacks are lost.

Beach Ceroba.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: The water's warm. Nothing else here is.
Beach Ceroba.VoiceLineAttackCaptions: You picked the wrong stretch of coast.
Beach Ceroba.VoiceLineSellCaptions: I'll be under the umbrella if you need me.
Beach Ceroba.Ability1VoicelineCaptions: The sand is going to remember this.
Beach Ceroba.Ability2VoicelineCaptions: Stay close to me. It gets bright.
Beach Ceroba.Ability3VoicelineCaptions: Everything burns eventually. Even a nice day.

Ability1.Name: HEAT HAZE
Ability1.Description: The air over the sand stops holding still. The most dangerous enemy in range walks into something that was never there and takes 0.94x current Damage for it.

Ability2.Name: HIGH TIDE, HIGH SUN
Ability2.Description: For 9.8s every tower in range is working under a sun Ceroba is holding steady on purpose, gaining +12% Damage and +6% Cooldown Reduction.

Ability3.Name: THE WHOLE COAST, BURNING
Ability3.Description: She stops treating the fire like a tool. Every enemy in range burns for 6.4s at 1.05x current Damage per second and the tideline glasses over.

Passive.Name: Sun Off The Water
Passive.Description: Sunlance is a hybrid of Pierce and Burn. Beach Ceroba focuses the glare coming off the water into a single beam that passes through every enemy in a straight line and sets each one alight, with enemies at the far end of the beam taking double Burn. Attacks also apply 40% SoulLeak for 5 seconds. Burning enemies in range accumulate Heatstroke, taking +6% Damage from all sources and losing 3% movement speed per stack, up to 15 stacks. Every 40 seconds she draws on the sun directly: for 10 seconds her Damage doubles, every enemy on screen is set alight regardless of range, and any enemy at 15 Heatstroke takes 25x current Damage. Enemies defeated at 15 stacks leave Glassed Sand that burns anything crossing it for the rest of the round.

Passive.Name: Beachball Bounce
Passive.Description: Attacks bounce to 2 additional enemies for 60% Damage each. Every bounce that lands adds +8% Damage to Beachball Lancer's next attack, up to +80%. Every 6th attack is a Spike, sending the ball down the entire lane for 2.5x current Damage.

Cantaloupe Susie.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: Don't. Say. Anything. About. The melon.
Cantaloupe Susie.Ability1VoicelineCaptions: I said DON'T LOOK AT ME.

Ability1.Name: ONE CLEAN SLICE
Ability1.Description: She stops swinging wildly for exactly one second, which is worse. The most dangerous enemy in range takes 1.39x current Damage in a single cut.

Ability2.Name: SEEDS EVERYWHERE
Ability2.Description: It goes badly and it goes everywhere. Every enemy in range takes 0.9x current Damage per second for 8.7s and none of it comes out of the carpet.

Ability3.Name: MELON SEASON
Ability3.Description: Susie decides the whole wave is produce. Everything in range is held for 5.1s taking 1.15x current Damage per second while she works through the crate.

Passive.Name: It Is Melon Season And She Has A Grudge
Passive.Description: Every 3rd attack is a Hyper Slash dealing 3.5x current Damage in a wide arc and applying 55% Bleed (Anti-Regen) for 5 seconds. Each enemy defeated this wave grants +5% Attack Speed, up to +120%, and every enemy defeated while Bleeding leaves a Rind on the lane. Rinds slow anything that crosses them by 50% and deal 2x her current Damage; up to 12 Rinds can exist at once and they persist for the entire round. At maximum Attack Speed every attack becomes a Hyper Slash.

Desert King.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: This kingdom has no walls. It does not need them.
Desert King.VoiceLineSellCaptions: The dunes will move on without me.

Ability1.Name: BURIED WHERE THEY STOOD
Ability1.Description: The ground stops being ground. The most dangerous enemy in range is taken down into it for 1.29x current Damage and the surface smooths over.

Ability2.Name: SANDSTORM SOVEREIGN
Ability2.Description: For 3.8s the storm belongs to whoever the King says it belongs to. Every enemy in range is held inside it taking 0.79x current Damage per second.

Passive.Name: The Dunes Answer To Him
Passive.Description: Slow, devastating attacks dealing full Damage in a 30-stud Nuke radius. Every 25 seconds the sand swallows the weakest non-Boss enemy in range instantly and leaves a Sinkhole for 10 seconds; enemies crossing a Sinkhole are slowed 60% and take 1x current Damage per second. Maximum 3 Sinkholes at once.

Ability1.Name: SANDCUTTER
Ability1.Description: One swing, taken at the end of a very long walk. Every enemy in range takes 1.19x current Damage and a thin line of sand hangs in the air afterwards.

Passive.Name: A Long Walk With A Sword
Passive.Description: Every 3rd attack deals 2.5x current Damage. Dune Kris gains one Mile every 4 seconds on the board (maximum 30), each granting +2% Damage and +0.5% Range. Standing within 15 studs of another Desert unit doubles the rate at which Miles accumulate.

Passive.Name: Too Hot For This
Passive.Description: Gains +8% Attack Speed for every 10 seconds spent on the board, up to +48%. Every 4th attack applies 45% Bleed (Anti-Regen) for 4 seconds and blinds the target for 1 second, preventing it from attacking. Bleeding enemies take +20% Damage from Desert units.

Passive.Name: Not Actually There
Passive.Description: Enemy attacks aimed at Mirage Tenna have a 25% chance to miss entirely. Every 18 seconds he projects a Mirage: a duplicate that attacks with 60% of his current Damage for 8 seconds and cannot be targeted or damaged.

Passive.Name: Cold Water In A Hot Place
Passive.Description: Attacks slow every enemy in range. While at least one enemy is slowed, all towers in range gain +12% Damage. Every 25 seconds Nomad Noelle shares the canteen, healing every allied unit in range for 20% of their maximum Health and clearing Burn from them.

Passive.Name: Knows The Route
Passive.Description: Grants all towers in range +12% Range. Every 15 seconds he Reads The Stars, marking the strongest enemy in range for 6 seconds; marked enemies take +35% Damage from all sources and are always targeted first by every tower in range.

Passive.Name: Somewhere To Stop
Passive.Description: Heals allied units in range on a timer while still attacking. Units healed gain Rested for 5 seconds: +8% Range and +8% Damage. Every 25 seconds Oasis Flowery pools its water, healing every allied unit in range to full if fewer than 3 are damaged.

Ability1.Name: THE SEAL BREAKS
Ability1.Description: Something that was walled in on purpose is no longer walled in. Every enemy in range takes 1.21x current Damage as the chamber opens.

Passive.Name: Buried, Not Gone
Passive.Description: Fires three piercing beams that apply 35% SoulLeak for 4 seconds and ignore all enemy damage reduction. Every 40 seconds a Chamber opens beneath the lane: every enemy in range is pulled 8 studs backwards and takes 6x current Damage. Enemies defeated by a Chamber cannot be revived or respawned by any means.

Passive.Name: Dressed For Eternity
Passive.Description: Grants all towers in range +12% Damage. Every 20 seconds she issues a Decree, choosing the highest-Damage tower in range and granting it +50% Damage for 6 seconds. While Desert King is on the board, Decree affects two towers instead of one.

Summer Ceroba.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: One afternoon off. That's all I wanted.
Summer Ceroba.VoiceLineAttackCaptions: You're standing between me and the water.
Summer Ceroba.VoiceLineSellCaptions: Save me a spot on the sand.
Summer Ceroba.Ability2VoicelineCaptions: Everyone step back from the shoreline.
Summer Ceroba.Ability3VoicelineCaptions: This is what the whole coast looks like on fire.

Ability1.Name: NOON, EXACTLY
Ability1.Description: The cone becomes the brightest thing on the map. The most dangerous enemy in range takes 1.24x current Damage and stops casting a shadow.

Ability2.Name: SUNSTROKE
Ability2.Description: For 3.6s every enemy in range is held under a heat that will not move, taking 0.86x current Damage per second.

Ability3.Name: THE LONGEST DAY
Ability3.Description: She stops letting the sun set. Everything in range burns for 8.9s at 0.95x current Damage per second under a sky that refuses to change.

Passive.Name: She Did Not Come Here To Relax
Passive.Description: Fires continuously in a cone, setting everything alight. Burn from Summer Ceroba stacks up to 10 times and never falls off while the enemy remains in range. Every 45 seconds she calls Noon: for 12 seconds the cone widens to a full circle, all Burn on screen is doubled, and every enemy at 10 stacks takes 15x current Damage instantly. Enemies defeated during Noon permanently grant +2% Damage for the round.

Summer Toriel.VoiceLineAttackCaptions: I did ask you to behave.
Summer Toriel.VoiceLineSellCaptions: Come along, then. Out of the sun.
Summer Toriel.Ability2VoicelineCaptions: I am afraid I must insist.

Ability1.Name: A MOTHER'S FIRE
Ability1.Description: The polite tone does not change. Every enemy in range takes 1.28x current Damage anyway.

Ability2.Name: SHADE FOR EVERYONE
Ability2.Description: For 8.1s every tower in range is looked after properly, gaining +12% Damage and +5% Cooldown Reduction.

Passive.Name: Sunscreen Was Non-Negotiable
Passive.Description: Attacks set enemies alight. All towers in range take 25% reduced Damage, cannot be Burned, and have all Burn and Bleed cleared from them every 5 seconds. Every 30 seconds Summer Toriel raises the heat, doubling the Burn damage of every Fire unit on the board for 10 seconds.

Passive.Name: Nobody Drowns On My Watch
Passive.Description: Attacks pierce every enemy in a straight line. Once per wave, the first allied unit in range to drop below 20% Health is instantly restored to full and made immune to damage for 2 seconds. Each rescue grants Lifeguard Undyne +25% Damage for the rest of the round.

Passive.Name: oh... i brought my mixtape...
Passive.Description: Deals continuous Damage to everything in range. Enemies in range are Dampened: they deal 25% less damage and their attack cooldowns are 20% longer. Beach Napstablook cannot be targeted by enemies while at least 3 enemies are Dampened.

Passive.Name: Off Duty, Still Armed
Passive.Description: Fires two piercing shots at separate targets. Every 5th attack is a Trick Shot, ricocheting between up to 4 enemies for 2x current Damage. Trick Shots that defeat an enemy immediately reset the counter.

Passive.Name: Wings Out, Feet Up
Passive.Description: Attacks hit in a wide cone. Beach Martlet gains +25% Damage while no enemy has escaped this wave. Every 18 seconds she takes off, becoming untargetable for 3 seconds and returning with a Dive that deals 3x current Damage to everything in the cone.

Passive.Name: Thou Art Cordially Roasted
Passive.Description: Attacks set enemies alight, and Burning enemies take +30% Damage from all sources. Every 22 seconds Tiki Rouxls Kaard lights the Torches, applying his full Burn to every enemy on screen regardless of range.

Passive.Name: tEM GO UNDERWATER!! (tem cannot swim)
Passive.Description: Every 6th attack Dives, making Snorkeler Temmie untargetable for 2 seconds and resurfacing for 3x current Damage in a doubled Splash radius. Each Dive that defeats an enemy grants 400 D$ and reduces the counter to every 4th attack for 10 seconds.

Passive.Name: Too Much Sun For A Vampire
Passive.Description: Slow, heavy attacks. 20% of all Damage dealt is converted into healing for the lowest-Health allied unit in range. Desert Dalv takes 30% more damage while no allied unit is within 10 studs, and 30% less while three or more are.

Passive.Name: [[Limited Time Offer, And Also Not Real]]
Passive.Description: Attacks chain to up to 4 enemies. Every 10th attack is a [[BIG SHOT]], dealing 3x current Damage and granting 750 D$. Enemies defeated by a [[BIG SHOT]] leave a Mirage that fights for 6 seconds with 50% of Mirage Spamton's current Damage.

Passive.Name: Sleeves Like Still Water
Passive.Description: Attacks slow enemies heavily, and slowed enemies take +25% Damage from all sources. Every 20 seconds Kimono Aqua stills the water, freezing every slowed enemy in range for 1.5 seconds and refreshing the slow on all of them.

Kimono Miss Mizzle.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: There is no need to rush any of this.
Kimono Miss Mizzle.VoiceLineSellCaptions: I will finish this another evening.

Ability1.Name: ONE FOLD, ONE CUT
Ability1.Description: The fan closes. The most dangerous enemy in range takes 1.33x current Damage before the sound of it reaches anyone.

Ability2.Name: THE LONG EVENING
Ability2.Description: For 5.3s time in the range is asked, politely, to be less urgent. Every enemy stands still taking 0.66x current Damage per second.

Passive.Name: Nothing Hurried About It
Passive.Description: Attacks slow heavily in a wide cone. Enemies slowed by her accumulate Stillness, losing a further 5% movement speed per second in range, to a maximum of 90%. Every 20 seconds she folds the fan, freezing every enemy in range for 2 seconds and dealing 5x current Damage to any enemy at maximum Stillness.

Kitsune Flowery.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: You'll want to count the tails. Go on.
Kitsune Flowery.Ability1VoicelineCaptions: Which one of me is real? Guess.
Kitsune Flowery.Ability2VoicelineCaptions: The fire was always the honest part.
Kitsune Flowery.Ability3VoicelineCaptions: All nine. At once. Do keep up.

Ability1.Name: FOXFIRE, PROPERLY
Ability1.Description: The pretty blue light stops being decorative. The most dangerous enemy in range takes 1.01x current Damage and there is nothing left to identify.

Ability2.Name: NINE OF ME
Ability2.Description: For 9.2s the range is full of Flowerys and only one of them is doing the damage, at 0.92x current Damage per second, and nobody can work out which.

Ability3.Name: THE TRICK, FINISHED
Ability3.Description: Every illusion in range closes at once. Enemies are held for 5.1s taking 1.1x current Damage per second inside a shape that was never there.

Passive.Name: Nine Tails, All Of Them Lying
Passive.Description: Attacks set enemies alight and apply 35% SoulLeak for 5 seconds. Every 30 seconds Kitsune Flowery splits into nine Illusions for 10 seconds; each Illusion attacks independently for 40% of her current Damage and cannot be targeted or damaged. Enemies attacking an Illusion instead take 3x her current Damage. Every enemy defeated by an Illusion adds one permanent tail, granting +4% Damage for the round with no cap.

Kitsune Ralsei.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: I promise the ears are traditional!

Ability1.Name: LANTERN PROCESSION
Ability1.Description: Rows of little flames go up all through the range at once and come down on every enemy in it for 1.36x current Damage.

Ability2.Name: BLESSING OF THE SHRINE
Ability2.Description: For 6.1s every tower in range is under the fox's protection, gaining +15% Damage and +8% Cooldown Reduction.

Passive.Name: A Very Polite Fox
Passive.Description: Attacks set enemies alight. All towers in range gain +18% Damage and +12% Range. Every 25 seconds Kitsune Ralsei lights a Lantern on the lane, up to 4; Lanterns burn every enemy within 15 studs for 60% of his current Damage per second and never expire while he remains on the board.

Ability1.Name: IAI
Ability1.Description: Nothing appears to happen. Then the most dangerous enemy in range takes 1.23x current Damage and both blades are already back in their sheaths.

Passive.Name: No Master, Two Blades
Passive.Description: Attacks strike twice. Every 5th attack deals 3x current Damage and ignores all enemy damage reduction. Ronin Mantis Lady gains +35% Damage while no booster unit is in range. Any enemy below 20% Health struck by the 5th attack is executed instantly (Bosses excluded).

Passive.Name: Doesn't Take Orders
Passive.Description: Gains +40% Damage while no booster unit is in range, and loses 10% Damage for each booster that is. Every 3rd attack is a Wide Swing dealing 2.5x current Damage to all enemies in a wide arc and applying 40% Bleed (Anti-Regen) for 4 seconds.

Shogun Netskie.Type: Cone Aoe + Damage & Cooldown Booster + Passive

Passive.Name: Command From The Back
Passive.Description: All towers in range deal more Damage and attack faster. Every 15 seconds Shogun Netskie issues an Order, causing every tower in range to attack instantly and ignore enemy damage reduction on that attack. Each Order also grants her +5% Damage for the round, up to +75%.

Shogun Tasque Manager.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: You are all late. Every one of you.
Shogun Tasque Manager.Ability2VoicelineCaptions: You will hold this line or I will find someone who can.
Shogun Tasque Manager.Ability3VoicelineCaptions: That is the last time I repeat myself.

Ability1.Name: THE ORDER GIVEN ONCE
Ability1.Description: She says it a single time. The most dangerous enemy in range takes 1.31x current Damage for not having listened.

Ability2.Name: FULL MOBILISATION
Ability2.Description: For 6.7s every tower in range moves like it has been drilled for years, gaining +12% Damage and +12% Cooldown Reduction.

Ability3.Name: HALT THE FIELD
Ability3.Description: The whole engagement stops because she decided it stops. Every enemy in range is held for 4.8s taking 0.86x current Damage per second.

Passive.Name: Everyone Is On Her Schedule Now
Passive.Description: Warfan is a hybrid of Chain and Stun. She throws an iron tessen that ricochets between up to 12 enemies dealing full Damage and Stunning each for 0.5 seconds, then retraces the same path on the return throw, striking every enemy a second time. Each enemy stunned is placed On The Schedule, taking +5% Damage from all sources per stun received with no cap, for the rest of the round. Every 35 seconds she Halts The Field: every enemy on screen is Stunned for 3 seconds, every allied ability cooldown drops by 8 seconds, and every tower on the board attacks once immediately. Any enemy defeated while Stunned by her is Reassigned, fighting for the player for 15 seconds with the Health it had left, up to 20 at once.

Passive.Name: Borrowed Stance
Passive.Description: Every 3rd attack is a Kata strike dealing 2.5x current Damage in a wide arc. Each Kata that hits 3 or more enemies grants Samurai Kris +6% Damage for the rest of the round, up to +60%. While Samurai Noelle is on the board, Kata triggers every 2nd attack instead.

Passive.Name: Trying Her Best
Passive.Description: Samurai Noelle builds one point of Form per attack and loses all of it whenever she takes damage. Each point grants +3% Damage and +1% Attack Speed with no cap. At 20 Form she enters Correct Stance, and her attacks pierce 2 enemies until Form is lost.

Ability1.Name: FIREWORKS OVER THE RIVER
Ability1.Description: The sky goes bright over the whole lane and comes down as 0.94x current Damage on everything in range. Everyone agrees it was a good show.

Passive.Name: Festival Fire
Passive.Description: Attacks set enemies alight. Burn from Yukata Ceroba deals +30% more Damage for each other Fire unit on the board. Every 25 seconds she launches a Firework: 5x current Damage in a large Splash that applies her full Burn to everything hit, regardless of range.

Passive.Name: LIVE FROM THE FESTIVAL!
Passive.Description: Grants all towers in range +12% Damage. Every 20 seconds Yukata Tenna calls a Highlight on a random tower in range, doubling its Damage for 5 seconds and making its next attack hit every enemy in Tenna's range as well.

Passive.Name: Retained, Not Owned
Passive.Description: Fires three piercing shots that apply 25% SoulLeak for 3 seconds. Every 25 seconds she Requisitions the strongest tower in range, copying 30% of its current Damage onto her own for 10 seconds. Cannot Requisition the same tower twice in a row.

Passive.Name: Thine Humble (Extremely Ranked) Servant
Passive.Description: Grants all towers in range +12% Damage. Every 12 seconds he Rearrangeth The Field, pushing all enemies in range back 6 studs and holding them for 1 second. Enemies pushed into other enemies deal 1x his current Damage to them on impact.

Passive.Name: A Very Large Club
Passive.Description: Slow, devastating attacks dealing full Damage in a 30-stud Nuke radius. Every 4th attack stuns everything hit for 1.5 seconds and cracks the ground, leaving a zone that slows by 50% for 6 seconds. While Oni Toriel is on the board, the zone also burns for 25% of his current Damage per second.

Passive.Name: Horns Suit Her, Unfortunately
Passive.Description: Attacks set enemies alight in a wide cone and deal +45% Damage to enemies already Burning. Every 20 seconds Oni Toriel exhales fully, doubling all Burn stacks on every enemy in range and extending their duration by 5 seconds.

Ability1.Name: THE SWORD, DRAWN PROPERLY
Ability1.Description: It is not a practice swing this time. Every enemy in range takes 1.38x current Damage in one motion that nobody watching quite catches.

Passive.Name: The Blade The Story Needed
Passive.Description: Every 3rd attack deals 3x current Damage and cannot be blocked or reduced. While both other Knights are on the board all three gain +35% Damage and form the Round Table: any enemy struck by all three Knights within 5 seconds takes 10x Knight Kris's current Damage and is stunned for 2 seconds.

Ability1.Name: OATH OF THE THIRD KNIGHT
Ability1.Description: For 6.4s every tower in range is standing behind something that has decided not to move, gaining +13% Damage and +8% Cooldown Reduction.

Passive.Name: The Shield The Story Needed
Passive.Description: Heals allied units on a timer and reduces damage they take by 30%. While both other Knights are on the board all three gain +35% Damage and form the Round Table; Knight Ralsei then also grants every tower in range immunity to the first instance of damage they would take every 15 seconds.

Ability1.Name: STRAIGHT THROUGH THE MIDDLE
Ability1.Description: No plan, no formation, no hesitation. Every enemy in range takes 1.2x current Damage and the line is simply not there anymore.

Passive.Name: The Charge The Story Needed
Passive.Description: Every 3rd attack is a Hyper Slash dealing 3.5x current Damage in a wide arc. While both other Knights are on the board all three gain +35% Damage and form the Round Table; Knight Susie's Hyper Slash then also knocks every enemy hit back 12 studs and applies 60% Bleed (Anti-Regen) for 5 seconds.

Ability1.Name: FULL BROADSIDE
Ability1.Description: Every gun on the side of the ship goes at once. Every enemy in range takes 1.26x current Damage and the deck rolls hard to starboard.

Passive.Name: Every Gun On This Side
Passive.Description: Attacks fire a broadside that pierces every enemy in a line for full Damage. Every 5th broadside is Double-Shotted at 3x current Damage. Each enemy defeated by a broadside loads one Shot, up to 9; at 9 Shots the next broadside fires all of them at once for 1x current Damage per Shot across the whole lane.

Pirate Dess.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: Aye. Sure. Whatever. I've got the bat.
Pirate Dess.VoiceLineAttackCaptions: That one's going in the water.

Ability1.Name: OVER THE SIDE
Ability1.Description: One swing, taken without much interest, and the most dangerous enemy in range takes 0.95x current Damage and a very long trip over the rail.

Ability2.Name: DEAD IN THE WATER
Ability2.Description: For 4.9s nothing in range gets to move, taking 0.89x current Damage per second while Dess leans on the bat and waits.

Passive.Name: Wifflebat, But Nautical
Passive.Description: Slow, heavy attacks that stun everything hit, and stunned enemies take +50% Damage from all sources. Every 4th swing sends the target flying 20 studs backwards, dealing 3x current Damage to every enemy it collides with on the way. Enemies knocked into the spawn point take a further 5x current Damage.

Ability1.Name: THE BOARDING
Ability1.Description: It steps across without a word. Every enemy in range takes 1x current Damage and the other deck goes quiet.

Ability2.Name: NO QUARTER
Ability2.Description: For 3.2s nothing in range is permitted to leave, taking 0.92x current Damage per second while the silence continues.

Passive.Name: Boarding Party Of One
Passive.Description: Slow, devastating attacks dealing full Damage in a 30-stud Nuke radius and ignoring all enemy damage reduction. Every 40 seconds Pirate Knight Boards: it becomes untargetable for 5 seconds while attacking at double speed, and every enemy it defeats during a Boarding does not count toward wave completion for the enemy team. Says nothing throughout.

Passive.Name: Cutlass Weather
Passive.Description: Every 3rd attack deals 2.5x current Damage and applies 35% Bleed (Anti-Regen) for 4 seconds. Bleeding enemies defeated in range drop 2x D$. While Pirate Susie is on the board, Bleed from both units stacks up to 4 times.

Passive.Name: CANNONBALL!!
Passive.Description: Attacks deal full Damage to the primary target and 50% to everything within 10 studs. Every 6th shot is Double-Shotted, dealing 3x current Damage and knocking everything hit back 8 studs. Each enemy defeated by an explosion adds +3% explosion radius for the round, up to +60%.

Passive.Name: Headbutts The Mast
Passive.Description: Deals +50% Damage to the leading enemy in the lane. Each attack builds Momentum, adding +10% Damage to the next attack, up to +100%; Momentum resets on target change. At full Momentum the next attack knocks the target back 10 studs.

Passive.Name: Ship's Cook, Ship's Medic, Ship's Everything
Passive.Description: Pirate Ralsei serves a Ration to the lowest-Health allied unit in range on a timer, healing it and granting +10% Damage for 8 seconds. Every 20 seconds he serves the whole crew instead, healing every allied unit in range at once and clearing all debuffs from them.

Ability1.Name: ONE SHOT FROM THE TOPS
Ability1.Description: He has been lining this up since the wave spawned. The most dangerous enemy in range takes 1.36x current Damage and the rest of the line notices.

Passive.Name: Crow's Nest Shot
Passive.Description: Very long range. Attacks pierce every enemy in a straight line and deal +45% Damage to the furthest enemy in the line. Each second Pirate Seth spends without firing adds one Lay stack, up to 8, each granting +20% Damage to the next shot. A shot fired at 8 Lay stacks also stuns everything in the line for 1.5 seconds.

Passive.Name: Mutiny Is A Team Sport
Passive.Description: Every 3rd attack is a Hyper Slash dealing 3x current Damage in a wide arc. Gains +20% Damage for each other Pirate unit on the board. Every Hyper Slash that hits 5 or more enemies calls a Mutiny, granting every Pirate unit on the board +25% Attack Speed for 8 seconds.

Ability1.Name: PACKET LOSS
Ability1.Description: The attack arrives before it is sent. Every enemy in range takes 1.37x current Damage twice and the log only records it once.

Passive.Name: Something Is Wrong With The Water
Passive.Description: Attacks apply 30% SoulLeak for 4 seconds. Every 8th attack Desyncs, resolving twice in the same frame against the same targets. Each Desync has a 25% chance not to consume the counter, which can chain indefinitely. Desynced damage cannot be reduced.

Ability1.Name: INTEGER OVERFLOW
Ability1.Description: For 10s every tower in range is running on numbers that should not fit, gaining +10% Damage and +8% Cooldown Reduction.

Passive.Name: Healing Value Out Of Range
Passive.Description: Heals allied units on a timer while attacking. Healing beyond a unit's maximum instead becomes Overheal, a shield worth up to 50% of that unit's maximum Health that also grants +25% Damage while it holds. Every 30 seconds Bug Blue Overheals every allied unit in range at once.

Bug Flowery.VoiceLineAttackCaptions: THIS IS F1NE TH1S IS F1NE THIS 1S F-

Ability1.Name: SOFTLOCK
Ability1.Description: The frame stops advancing for everyone but Flowery. Every enemy in range is held for 3.4s taking 0.44x current Damage per second inside the same tenth of a second.

Ability2.Name: MEMORY LEAK
Ability2.Description: Something keeps allocating and nothing frees it. Everything in range takes 1.29x current Damage per second for 8.8s as the range fills up with copies.

Passive.Name: Repeating Frame
Passive.Description: Fires continuously, piercing every enemy in a line, applying 35% SoulLeak for 5 seconds and ignoring all enemy damage reduction. Every 30 seconds the frame stops advancing for 4 seconds: every enemy in range is frozen exactly where it stands, takes 2x current Damage per second, and any enemy defeated during this leaves a duplicate of itself that fights for the player for 10 seconds.

Ability1.Name: INFINITE LOOP
Ability1.Description: The chain finds its way back to the start and does not stop finding its way back to the start. Every enemy in range takes 1.06x current Damage per second for 6s.

Passive.Name: Chain Length Undefined
Passive.Description: Attacks chain to up to 6 enemies with no damage falloff. Each chain has a 20% chance to loop back to an enemy it has already hit, and looped hits can loop again up to 4 times. Every 25 seconds the chain length is set to Undefined for 6 seconds, hitting every enemy in range per attack.

Ability1.Name: UNCAUGHT EXCEPTION
Ability1.Description: Whatever was supposed to catch this did not. Every enemy in range takes 1.33x current Damage and the handler never runs.

Passive.Name: Burn Value Not Sanitised
Passive.Description: Attacks set enemies alight, and Burn stacks without limit while the enemy remains in range. Every 10 stacks on a single enemy causes an Overflow: that enemy takes 3x Bug Orange's current Damage instantly and every enemy within 12 studs gains 3 Burn stacks.

Ability1.Name: OUT OF BOUNDS
Ability1.Description: The shot leaves the intended array. Every enemy in range takes 1.26x current Damage from somewhere off the edge of the map.

Passive.Name: Three Shots, Two Registered
Passive.Description: Fires three piercing shots that ignore all enemy damage reduction. Each shot has a 30% chance to register twice. Every 20 seconds Bug Seth fires Out Of Bounds, hitting every enemy on screen once for 1.5x current Damage regardless of range or walls.

Ability1.Name: HARD FREEZE
Ability1.Description: Nothing in range gets another update for 5s. They stand there taking 0.57x current Damage per second, waiting for a tick that isn't coming.

Passive.Name: Stun Duration Not Clamped
Passive.Description: Slow, heavy attacks that stun. Each time the same enemy is stunned, the stun duration increases by 0.25 seconds with no upper limit, persisting for the whole round. Enemies stunned for 4 seconds or longer take +80% Damage from all sources and cannot be healed.

Ability1.Name: LOCKED FROM THE OUTSIDE
Ability1.Description: Every enemy in range is inside it for 5.1s, taking 0.62x current Damage per second, and the mechanism is not on their side of the bars.

Passive.Name: Nothing Leaves
Passive.Description: Enemies entering range are held in place for 3 seconds (8 second cooldown per enemy) and take +35% Damage from all sources while held. Every enemy defeated while held reinforces the bars, permanently reducing the per-enemy cooldown by 0.1 seconds for the round, to a minimum of 2 seconds. While Cage Animals is on the board, held enemies are also unable to attack.

Dreamwatcher.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: You were asleep. It was not.
Dreamwatcher.VoiceLineSellCaptions: It closes one eye. Only one.
Dreamwatcher.Ability1VoicelineCaptions: Do not look directly at it.
Dreamwatcher.Ability2VoicelineCaptions: It has been counting all of you.

Ability1.Name: THE LONG LOOK
Ability1.Description: It finally focuses on one thing. The most dangerous enemy in range takes 1.35x current Damage and is not looked at again.

Ability2.Name: SLEEP PARALYSIS
Ability2.Description: For 4.5s nothing in range can move while it is being observed, taking 0.78x current Damage per second under the attention.

Passive.Name: It Has Been Awake This Whole Time
Passive.Description: Fires continuously in a cone. Enemies in the cone deal 40% less damage, cannot regenerate, and are Observed. Observed enemies take +5% Damage from all sources per second in the cone, up to +100%, and lose it at 10% per second once out. Enemies defeated at maximum Observation grant every tower in range +10% Damage for 8 seconds.

Dreamwarden.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: You are not supposed to be in here.
Dreamwarden.VoiceLineAttackCaptions: This one does not get to finish.
Dreamwarden.VoiceLineSellCaptions: The door closes. Go back to sleep.
Dreamwarden.Ability1VoicelineCaptions: Nothing in this room is real. Including you.
Dreamwarden.Ability2VoicelineCaptions: Every unfinished thing, all at once.

Ability1.Name: UNMADE
Ability1.Description: The most dangerous enemy in range takes 0.92x current Damage and, more importantly, stops having been there in the first place.

Ability2.Name: EVERY UNFINISHED THING
Ability2.Description: For 8.7s the range fills with what never got completed, dealing 1.02x current Damage per second to everything standing in it.

Ability3.Name: THE ROOM WITH NO DOOR
Ability3.Description: Every enemy in range is held inside it for 4.9s at 1.15x current Damage per second, looking for a way out that was never built.

Passive.Name: Keeper Of Everything Left Unfinished
Passive.Description: Slow, devastating attacks dealing full Damage in a 30-stud Nuke radius and ignoring all enemy damage reduction. Every 40 seconds the Dreamwarden Unmakes the weakest non-Boss enemy on screen entirely, removing it without a death, and leaves an Unfinished Thing where it stood. Unfinished Things are permanent, deal 5x current Damage to any enemy that touches them, and lower that enemy's maximum Health and movement speed by 20% for the rest of the round. Maximum 8 Unfinished Things.

Superflowery.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: Howdy! You've made an excellent purchase.
Superflowery.VoiceLineAttackCaptions: This is what the flower was always for.
Superflowery.Ability2VoicelineCaptions: Everyone gets to see this one.

Ability1.Name: PETAL NOVA
Ability1.Description: It opens all the way and does not stop opening. Every enemy in range takes 1.37x current Damage from a flower that has stopped pretending to be one.

Ability2.Name: SUPER BLOOM
Ability2.Description: For 8.6s every tower in range is growing in the same soil, gaining +13% Damage and +10% Cooldown Reduction.

Passive.Name: Golly, That's A Lot Of Power
Passive.Description: Slow, devastating attacks dealing full Damage in a 30-stud Nuke radius and ignoring all enemy damage reduction. All towers in range gain +25% Damage. Every enemy defeated feeds the bloom, permanently granting Superflowery +1% Damage for the round with no cap; at 100 stacks its attacks also stun for 1 second.

Silent Knight.VoiceLineAttackCaptions: (the snow under it does not crunch)
Silent Knight.Ability2VoicelineCaptions: (something enormous moves, and you hear none of it)

Ability1.Name: THE QUIET PART
Ability1.Description: The lane goes completely silent for a moment nobody can describe afterwards. The most dangerous enemy in range takes 0.92x current Damage without a single sound being made.

Ability2.Name: HELD BREATH
Ability2.Description: For 5.1s nothing in range is able to make a noise or a move, taking 0.89x current Damage per second inside a silence that will not lift.

Passive.Name: Not One Sound
Passive.Description: Enemies struck by Silent Knight are Silenced for 6 seconds: they cannot use abilities, heal, buff other enemies, or call reinforcements, and they make no sound cue when they attack. Silent Knight gains +8% Damage for every Silenced enemy on screen, up to +80%. While no enemy in range is Silenced it cannot be seen or targeted by enemies at all. It never speaks, and no ability, passive or Act belonging to any unit can force it to.

Holly Knight.VoiceLinePlaceCaptions: The wreath goes on the door. You go through it.
Holly Knight.VoiceLineSellCaptions: Take it down before the season turns.
Holly Knight.Ability1VoicelineCaptions: The whole hedge, all at once.

Ability1.Name: THORN VOLLEY
Ability1.Description: The wreath comes apart into every spine it was ever made of, dealing 1.17x current Damage to every enemy in range on the way past.

Ability2.Name: THE HEDGE CLOSES
Ability2.Description: Holly grows across the whole lane for 6.4s, dealing 0.7x current Damage per second to everything still trying to push through it.

Passive.Name: Wreath Of Thorns
Passive.Description: Fires three thorn volleys that pierce every enemy in a straight line and apply 40% Bleed (Anti-Regen) for 5 seconds. Every enemy defeated while Bleeding drops one Berry, up to 12; each Berry grants Holly Knight +4% Damage and +2% Range for the rest of the round. At 12 Berries the wreath closes: every enemy entering range is immediately Bled without being hit, and Holly Knight's Bleed can no longer be cleansed by any enemy.

Ability1.Name: ACE
Ability1.Description: Kris serves once, into the only gap on the court. Every enemy in the line takes 1.22x current Damage and none of them saw where it landed.

Passive.Name: Down The Line
Passive.Description: Attacks pierce every enemy in a straight line and deal +40% Damage to the furthest enemy hit. Kris opens the Rally: each attack adds one Rally point shared by all three Tennis Players, up to 20. Every Rally point grants all three +3% Damage. The Rally is lost if no Tennis Player attacks for 5 seconds. While all three are on the board, Kris's shots cannot be blocked or reduced.

Ability1.Name: THE LONG RALLY
Ability1.Description: Ralsei simply returns everything for 7.9s, and the whole court is worked over at 0.68x current Damage per second while nobody manages to end the point.

Passive.Name: Perfect Lob
Passive.Description: Attacks arc over the front rank and land on the enemy furthest from Ralsei, dealing full Splash Damage and slowing everything hit by 35% for 3 seconds. Ralsei keeps the Rally alive: while he is on the board the shared Rally never decays below 10 points, and each of his attacks adds two points instead of one. While all three Tennis Players are on the board, every Rally point also grants them +1% Attack Speed.

Ability1.Name: MATCH POINT
Ability1.Description: She has been waiting the entire set for a ball this high. Every enemy in range takes 1.07x current Damage and the net does not survive either.

Passive.Name: Overhead Smash
Passive.Description: Slow, heavy attacks that deal full Damage in a 30-stud Nuke radius and stun everything hit for 1 second. Susie spends the Rally: at 20 shared Rally points her next attack is a Smash dealing 12x current Damage and knocking every enemy hit back 15 studs, consuming the whole Rally. While all three Tennis Players are on the board a Smash also refunds 6 seconds of every Tennis Player's ability cooldown.
